title: Efficient and Accurate Causal Validation of Training Data Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.19451v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal validation of training data attribution (TDA) methods is costly, since evaluation involves retraining a model on many different subsets of the original training set. For example, the Linear Datamodeling Score (LDS), which has become a standard metric for evaluating TDA methods, measures the correlation between TDA predictions and expected retrained model outputs. In this paper, we reduce the amount of computation needed to estimate the LDS along three axes: the number of sampled training subsets, the number of retraining seeds per subset, and the number of models in the attribution ensemble. Each of these factors induces a form of bias in the LDS estimation, and removing these sources of bias significantly reduces the number of retrainings needed to match the same accuracy in LDS estimation. On ResNet-9/CIFAR-10, finite-subset debiasing achieves $3.2\%$ relative RMSE with as few as $4$ subsets, and $32$ subsets match the accuracy

translated_title: 训练数据归因的高效且精确的因果验证
translated_abstract: 训练数据归因（TDA）方法的因果验证代价高昂，因为评估过程需要在原始训练集的许多不同子集上重新训练模型。例如，线性数据建模分数（LDS）已成为评估TDA方法的标准指标，它衡量的是TDA预测值与预期的重训练模型输出之间的相关性。在本文中，我们从三个维度减少了估计LDS所需的计算量：采样的训练子集数量、每个子集的重训练随机种子数量，以及归因集成中的模型数量。上述每个因素都会在LDS估计中引入某种形式的偏差，而消除这些偏差来源可以显著减少在LDS估计中达到相同精度所需的重训练次数。在ResNet-9/CIFAR-10上，有限子集去偏差方法仅使用4个子集就实现了3.2%的相对RMSE，而32个子集即可匹配原有方法的精度。
tldr: 该论文提出从训练子集数量、重训练种子数和归因集成模型数三个维度对LDS估计进行去偏差，从而大幅降低训练数据归因因果验证所需的重新训练计算量，同时保持估计精度。
en_tdlr: This paper reduces the computational cost of causally validating training data attribution methods by debiasing LDS estimation along three axes—the number of training subsets, retraining seeds, and attribution ensemble size—significantly cutting the required retrainings while maintaining accuracy.
